name: Slippers of Spider Climbing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Climb walls and walk on ceilings with your hands free, at your Speed.
text: Wearing these soft shoes, you can walk up, down and across walls and upside down along ceilings without using your hands, and your Climb Speed matches your Speed. They don't work on slick surfaces, such as ones coated in ice or oil.
